xmldoc.short_description: Ouvre une boite de dialogue de selection de dossier.

param_input_item.param_description: Initial directory. If the path is not a directory, the current folder is used.

description.p: uigetdir lets the user choose a directory.

example_item.example_item_description: Apercu d une boite de selection de dossier.
Start directory selection in the temporary folder.
example_item.example_item_data: path = uigetdir(tempdir(), 'Select temporary folder'); if ~isequal(path, 0), disp(path); end
